visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and glasses is seated at a light-colored wooden table in a well-lit indoor space. A hand enters the frame from the left, holding a smartphone with a prominent camera module and a case featuring a circular logo. The woman looks at the person off-camera with a neutral expression while wearing a white lace-trimmed sleeveless top. (2) The focus shifts to the smartphone screen as a hand navigates through the iOS settings menu. The environment remains bright with a small green plant in a white pot and a blurred living area in the background. (3) A close-up of the phone shows the 'Accessibility' settings being adjusted, specifically looking for 'Head Tracking'. Fingers interact with the touch screen to toggle various options. (4) The woman is shown again, now attempting to use the phone with facial gestures. She sticks her tongue out while looking at the screen. At one point, a cartoon girl avatar with its tongue out is overlaid on her face to emphasize the action. (5) She continues the experiment, now wrinkling her nose to scroll up through an article on the screen. Her facial expressions are animated and focused. (6) In the final phase, she reacts with laughter and surprise to the feature's sensitivity. She leans toward the phone and playfully licks the screen directly, concluding with a wide-eyed, humorous expression.
